A '''vendor droid''', also known as a '''shopkeeper droid''', was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] assigned to sell merchandise.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], vendor droids are all named after the items they sell:
*[[5WO-OP]] - [[Speeder bike/Legends|Speeder bike]]
*[[80-T5]] - [[Droid/Legends|Droids]]
*[[AR-M33]] - [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|Clone trooper armor]]
*[[GL1-D3]] - [[Jedi starfighter]]s
*[[H0-U53]] - Furniture
*[[5A8-3R]] - [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsabers]]
